summary.para: If true, and the index has replicas, ILM first clones the index with zero replicas and force merges the clone, so that replicas are not merged redundantly. If false, the managed index is force merged directly. Not allowed when force_merge_index is false.

The period for which the mounted index keeps one replica before the replica is removed. By default, the index is mounted without replicas. Must be positive. Only the first searchable_snapshot action in a policy may set this. It must fit before the next phase starts: for example, if this phase has a min_age of 5d and the next phase has 12d, it can be at most 7d.
The maximum number of shards, including primaries and replicas, that can be allocated to any single node for the mounted index. Must be at least 1.
